violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Water served safe and sanitary (26 TAC §746.3301(f)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Water served safe and sanitary
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined that unsanitary drinking water was being served to children.

finding_variants.text: It was determined that unsanitary drinking water was being served to children.

Observed a bottle in the refrigerator with water in it and it had dried food around the nipple of the bottle. I spoke with the caregivers about ensuring that the bottles are cleaned each day or sent home to be cleaned.
Observed that water was not served to children during breakfast.
Children returned from outdoor activities and were not served water. This was corrected at inspection with director directing the staff to serve water.

Based on information gathered, it was determined that caregiver gave a child water in a sippy cup that was not thoroughly washed from the inside of the valve/collar that had mold in the valve/collar of the sippy cup, therefore water was not served in a safe and sanitary manner.    Note:  This was corrected prior to inspection when the operation only uses disposable cups, and all other extra sippy cup were disposed.
A caregiver and child had similar store-bought water bottles in the classroom.  Due to the water bottles not being labeled properly, a caregiver's water was poured into a child's drink cup.
